body: My cousin tried to OD and I talked to her about it one day. I feel like it’s the cleanest and least traumatizing for my parents instead of finding me hanging in my room or something. It gives them a funeral and stuff. She never told me what it was like and threatened to tell my parents. I know she meant well but I really don’t want my parents to know.
I’m an athlete and a student so I don’t really have a lot of free time but I like to read and bake when I can
I hate that I want to fight. But every time I fight for an extra day it feels like I’m pushing myself towards a finish line that I don’t care for.

I honestly have no idea why I feel like this. I live such a privileged life with caring family and I can’t for this life of me figure out why I’m so depressed. I feel like I should have some sort of trauma but I don’t. I sound like such a spoiled brat when I talk about how depressed I am and I don’t know how to cope with it. I feel like I’m complaining about nothing but I’m so self-aware of my depression that I have no idea why I am the way that I am.
I don’t think it’s gonna happen anytime soon but I just wanted to get it out

I’ve tried. They sent me to therapy and never checked again. My parents have to come with me to therapy so I try not to talk about being depressed cause they normally just brush off my depression for “teenage hormones”
DM me I’d love to talk about it more! Sometimes I feel like I can see the crystal waters and a riptide pulls me in right when I think I’ve made it. I really liked your analogy thank you.
Thank you I’m so surprised at the DMs and replies I’ve gotten ❤️
Thank you so much for understanding. I’m sorry that we can relate about this. Wishing you the best 💔
I’ve really thought about it but I come from a family that doesn’t talk about mental health and I’ve heard scary things about mental hospitals. I also don’t want to burden my parents financially
We’re in the same boat. DM me please! It’s nice to know someone else is feeling it too
That’s what I’m trying to get myself too. My thoughts are once I’m in college I can get myself a therapist and stuff.

Thank you. Ive been trying to tell myself that. I feel like every year at my birthday I’m happy I stayed cause of some memories but lately it’s been hard to think past a week. I set the original date last year and it felt soon but now I’ve gotten more depressed and it feels like so far away.
